purpose: Seed registry of data-only artifact contracts for LLMGameCreator. Contracts define what generator modules, LLM workflows, validators, exporters and runtime build steps are allowed to produce or consume.
principles: Contracts come before code: a new generator or runtime feature must declare which artifact contract it produces or consumes.
Artifacts are data-only unless explicitly marked as generated source output and passed through a dedicated codegen/export pipeline.
LLM output is draft until parsed, normalized, validated and promoted by deterministic C# services.
Lua modules may build IR, packs, plans and patch artifacts through restricted contracts, but must not act as unrestricted runtime authority.
Unity runtimes should consume compiled runtime data, Unity IR and asset indexes, not loose unbounded JSON dumps.
Adult/NSFW material is modeled as an optional content overlay and tagged artifact content, not as a default assumption or hidden side effect.

validation_levels.title: JSON and shape validation
validation_levels.summary: Valid JSON, required top-level fields and primitive data types.

validation_levels.title: IDs, enums and references
validation_levels.summary: Canonical IDs, stable enum values, duplicate detection and reference resolution.

validation_levels.title: Contract semantics
validation_levels.summary: Artifact-specific invariants, allowed sections, no forbidden operations and data-only boundaries.

validation_levels.title: Cross-artifact consistency
validation_levels.summary: Consistency across semantic packs, text packs, game package patches, Unity IR, asset indexes and runtime DB plans.

validation_levels.title: Headless smoke test
validation_levels.summary: Deterministic simulation or dry-run without Unity visuals.

validation_levels.title: Export dry-run
validation_levels.summary: Unity/runtime export checks, database build plan dry-run, asset binding checks and adapter compatibility.

validation_levels.title: Human approval
validation_levels.summary: Required for new capabilities, new artifact contracts, unsafe-impacting changes, story canon decisions and major runtime target changes.

contract_groups.title: Planning and capability artifacts
contract_groups.purpose: Game profiles, feature bundles, generator plans and capability expansion proposals.

contract_groups.title: Game content and semantic artifacts
contract_groups.purpose: Semantic facts, traits, rules, formulas, dialogues, text packs, morphology and content overlays.

contract_groups.title: Runtime export artifacts
contract_groups.purpose: Unity IR, runtime database build plans, asset indexes and save overlay schemas.

contract_groups.title: Media generation request artifacts
contract_groups.purpose: Image, audio, music, voice and future animation request packs generated from approved game data.

contract_groups.title: Validation and audit artifacts
contract_groups.purpose: Reports, smoke-test plans, dry-run results and audit records.

contracts.title: Game Profile
contracts.purpose: Declares the intended game type, runtime targets, required feature bundles, optional overlays and validation focus.
contracts.promotion_policy: Human approval required before this profile can drive generator plans.

contracts.title: Feature Bundle
contracts.purpose: Groups capabilities, dependencies, data contracts, runtime contracts, validators and runtime targets for one modular feature.
contracts.promotion_policy: New feature bundles require review because they affect future planning.

contracts.title: Generator Plan
contracts.purpose: Ordered plan of selected generator modules, configs, inputs, expected artifacts and validation gates.
contracts.promotion_policy: Draft plans may be saved; approved plans may produce preview artifacts but still must not auto-apply.

contracts.title: GamePackage Patch
contracts.purpose: Strict allowlisted data-only operations for changing GamePackage definitions through dry-run/apply/rollback.
contracts.promotion_policy: Requires dry-run diff and explicit user apply.

contracts.title: Semantic Pack
contracts.purpose: Reusable semantic definitions such as traits, tags, entity kinds, material profiles, relationships, world facts and constraints.
contracts.promotion_policy: Can be batch-generated, but canon-level facts require approval or explicit draft status.

contracts.title: Property Channel Pack
contracts.purpose: Declares reusable property channels for entity kinds, items, NPCs, locations, spells, buildings, skills, statuses and technical systems.
must_not: create unbounded arbitrary properties without type information
contracts.promotion_policy: New channels require review because they affect many generators and runtime tables.

contracts.title: Rule Pack
contracts.purpose: Data-only conditional rules for materials, weather, factions, reputation, abilities, reactions, generators and simulation logic.
must_not: directly mutate save state outside runtime actions
contracts.promotion_policy: Mechanical rule packs require simulation/dry-run before gameplay use.

contracts.title: Formula Pack
contracts.purpose: Safe formula IR for stats, combat, progression, economy, production and balance systems.
must_not: contain Lua/C#/JavaScript expressions as executable source
contracts.promotion_policy: Requires formula bounds and test vectors before runtime export.

contracts.title: Text Pack
contracts.purpose: Player-facing or editor-facing text templates, variants, phrase plans, surface strings and style rules.
contracts.promotion_policy: Batch text can be auto-staged; sensitive/canon texts may require sampled review or approval.

contracts.title: Morphology Pack
contracts.purpose: Language-specific lexemes, grammatical metadata, forms, agreement hints and phrase realization requirements.
must_not: treat LLM as the sole runtime morphology authority
contracts.promotion_policy: Prefer compiled forms; LLM-created entries require normalization and sampled review.

contracts.title: Dialogue Pack
contracts.purpose: Dialogue nodes, choices, facts, conditions, effects, speaker styles and route metadata.
must_not: change world state through free text
reference missing speakers or quest states
contracts.promotion_policy: Important story/canon dialogue requires review; generic barks may be batch-staged.

contracts.title: Free Text Dialogue Intent Pack
contracts.purpose: NLU/intent extraction contract for optional live typed dialogue with NPCs. It converts player text into proposed intents and claims, not direct world mutations.
must_not: accept player claims as facts without validation
mutate NPC memory before runtime verification
contracts.promotion_policy: Requires human approval because it changes live dialogue behavior.

contracts.title: Content Overlay Pack
contracts.purpose: Optional tagged content layers such as adult/NSFW, horror/gore, mature politics, relationship intensity or platform-specific filtering.
contracts.promotion_policy: Project-level explicit enable/disable decision required.

contracts.title: Unity IR
contracts.purpose: Unity-facing intermediate representation for scenes, prefab bindings, component bindings, UI screens, input actions, cameras, audio and VFX hooks.
must_not: contain arbitrary C# source by default
assume specific Asset Store packages without declared adapter
contracts.promotion_policy: Export dry-run required before Unity project application.

contracts.title: Runtime DB Build Plan
contracts.purpose: Plan for compiling validated package data, semantic packs, text packs, Unity IR and asset indexes into runtime lookup databases.
must_not: mix immutable runtime content and mutable save state without explicit overlay policy
write runtime DB during plan validation
ignore index requirements for large data
contracts.promotion_policy: May produce compiled DB only after source artifacts validate.

contracts.title: Asset Request Pack
contracts.purpose: Requests for sprites, portraits, tilesets, icons, prefabs or model placeholders generated from approved semantic/game data.
contracts.promotion_policy: Requests may be staged; actual generated media requires separate import/approval.

contracts.title: Image Request Pack
contracts.purpose: Detailed prompt/request data for image generation, including sprites, portraits, UI art, tiles, equipment overlays and scene illustrations.
must_not: overwrite existing asset ids without approval
be treated as imported asset until output is validated
contracts.promotion_policy: Generation request only; generated files need asset import and binding validation.

contracts.title: Audio Request Pack
contracts.purpose: Requests for music, ambience, UI sounds, spell sounds, combat sounds, voice placeholders and future voice lines.
must_not: replace existing audio bindings without approval
contracts.promotion_policy: Generation request only; generated audio needs asset import and binding validation.

contracts.title: Animation Request Pack
contracts.purpose: Future-facing request contract for animation generation or animation state planning, including sprite sheets, character states, VFX loops and scene animation metadata.
must_not: be required by core runtime before animation support exists
replace existing animation controllers without export dry-run
contracts.promotion_policy: Optional/future artifact; may be planned before implementation exists.

contracts.title: Asset Index
contracts.purpose: Stable mapping from game/entity/UI/audio IDs to imported asset paths, generated files, Unity addressables or external package references.
must_not: reference files not imported or declared
contracts.promotion_policy: Export dry-run required for Unity runtime use.

contracts.title: Save Overlay Schema
contracts.purpose: Schema for mutable save/world state separate from immutable runtime content database.
must_not: mix generated immutable data and mutable player state without explicit separation
allow arbitrary variable names without registration
contracts.promotion_policy: Human approval required because save compatibility is high impact.

contracts.title: Validation Report
contracts.purpose: Structured diagnostics from validation, import, dry-run, simulation, export and artifact promotion stages.
must_not: be generated solely by LLM without deterministic checks
contracts.promotion_policy: Reports are audit records and should be immutable after creation.

contracts.title: Headless Smoke Test Plan
contracts.purpose: Small deterministic simulation/test scenarios for validating gameplay systems, formulas, quests, economy and runtime DB lookups without Unity visuals.
contracts.promotion_policy: Should accompany mechanical feature bundles and runtime DB plans.
